create_skill_manage: create a new skill with skill_manage action=create providing full SKILL.md content with YAML frontmatter and category
edit_skill_manage: edit an existing skill with skill_manage action=edit providing the complete updated SKILL.md content
patch_skill_manage: patch a skill with skill_manage action=patch using old_string and new_string for targeted find-and-replace
delete_skill_manage: delete a user skill with skill_manage action=delete by name
write_file_skill_manage: write a supporting file to a skill with skill_manage action=write_file providing file_path and file_content under references templates scripts or assets
